title: Eating carrots helps more than eyesight
excerpt: Planning a romantic evening ? you might think a juicy steak, a good bottle of wine and some chocolate will set the stage .But you'd be wrong.
content: Planning a romantic evening ? you might think a juicy steak, a good bottle of wine and some chocolate will set the stage .But you'd be wrong. Saturated fats from meats, alcohol and chocolate are the exact things you'll want to avoid for good sex.Belleville News-Democrat 9.6.13
